name: HVAC Duct CFM Calculator
description: Estimate airflow through round or rectangular HVAC ducts from duct area and air velocity.
search_intent: Calculate duct airflow in CFM using duct dimensions and air velocity.
calculation: Round duct area = pi × (diameter/2)^2 converted from square inches to square feet. Rectangular duct area = width × height / 144 when dimensions are inches. Airflow CFM = cross-sectional area in ft² × velocity in ft/min. Return null for invalid dimensions.
limitations: This calculates airflow from area and velocity only.
It does not size ducts from static pressure, friction loss, fittings or fan performance.
Actual HVAC design should consider Manual D or other applicable engineering methods.
